get.description: Meal cancellations and optional meal requests for delivery dates in the range, plus a current snapshot of active subscriptions by plan type, billing cycle and auto-renew.
For customers registered in the range: registered → verified → subscribed → activated (first subscription started) → renewed (≥2 paid invoices).
New customers, first-time subscribers, churned customers, running total and active subscribers per bucket. Granularity defaults to day (≤31 days), week (≤92 days) or month.
Current snapshot placing each customer in one state, by precedence: active → payment_failed → pending → lapsed → never_subscribed.

KPI cards for the range, each compared with the previous period of equal length. Active/churn figures are reconstructed from subscription service windows (started_at → valid_until/cancelled_at). Dates are inclusive, Asia/Colombo; defaults to the last 30 days.
Customers ranked by revenue, paid invoices or meal cancellations within the range. Only customers with a non-zero value for the sort metric are listed.
Delivery volume, completion and cancellations in the range split by plan type, package or weekday.

Expected deliveries for each of the next N days starting today, split into FIXED and CUSTOM, with known cancellations and optional meal swaps. Uses ACTIVE subscriptions and assumes auto-renewing FIXED plans renew.
The most requested optional meals for delivery dates in the range, excluding cancelled requests.

Delivery KPIs for the range, each compared with the previous period of equal length. Expected deliveries are scheduled meals minus cancellations, rebuilt from every started subscription. Completion and missed only count closed days (before today); today's open work is pending_today. Late-marked = marked delivered after the delivery date. Dates are inclusive, Asia/Colombo; defaults to the last 30 days.
Scheduled, cancelled, expected, delivered and missed deliveries plus optional meal swaps per bucket, up to today. Granularity defaults to day (≤31 days), week (≤92 days) or month.
Net revenue in the range split by package, subscription plan, billing cycle or plan type, largest first, with share of total.
Customers grouped by the month of their first paid invoice; for each following month, how many paid again (retention %) and their net revenue. Covers the last N months including the current one.
Every discount redeemed on PAID invoices in the range: redemptions, unique customers, total and average discount, and net revenue of the discounted invoices.
First-checkout payment outcomes and recurring billing success in the range, the top recurring failure reasons, and the monthly recurring value of subscriptions currently in PAYMENT_FAILED.

Gross, discounts, net, wallet credit, cash collected and invoice count per bucket, with net revenue split into new (a subscription's first paid invoice) and renewal. Granularity defaults to day (≤31 days), week (≤92 days) or month.

Revenue KPIs for the range, each compared with the previous period of equal length. Revenue is recognised on PAID invoices by paid date: gross = subtotal, net = after discounts, cash collected = net minus wallet credit. MRR is the monthly-normalised recurring price of FIXED subscriptions in service at the end of each period. Refunds are wallet credits from meal cancellations. Dates are inclusive, Asia/Colombo; defaults to the last 30 days.
